Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager
Builds named connections from configuration the first time they are used and hands out the query, schema and migrator objects of each.

This package holds the typed configuration (ConnectionConfig, DatabaseConfig), the Connector factory interface that each database module implements, and the DatabaseManager that caches what the connectors build. The raw configuration sources live in org.aristonis.diwan.database.config.

This package does not hold a database driver, a JDBC URL builder or a connection pool: a connector builds its own data source, and a pool is plugged in through DatabaseManager.Builder.dataSource(String, java.util.function.Supplier).
